findings.motion: H958 Election Law Changes, second reading, roll call 758 (passed 66 to 47)
findings.note: Her vote is listed as Aye on her member vote page (https://www.ncleg.gov/Members/Votes/H/820). The ratified text (https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H958v9.pdf) includes a new G.S. 163-83 that says 'the county board shall process the voter registration application in accordance with this Article only if the voter registration application affirmatively indicates that the applicant is a citizen of the United States', a notice with 30 days to answer, and a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens from a federal database. Sections take effect 2027-01-01. The bill page (https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958) lists the governor's veto of H958 received 2026-08-17.

findings.motion: H834 State Board of Elections Administrative Changes, House concurrence, roll call 800 (passed 74 to 35)
findings.note: Her vote is listed as Aye on her member vote page (https://www.ncleg.gov/Members/Votes/H/820). The enacted text (Session Law 2026-60, https://www.ncleg.gov/Sessions/2025/Bills/House/PDF/H834v6.pdf) keeps photo ID for in-person voting and the provisional-ballot fallback for a voter without it, and moves the deadline to bring photo ID to the county board from the third to the fifth business day after the election; it also lets a voter fix a missing signature on a provisional-ballot affidavit.
